system.description:
Islands and coasts, with the sea always in view. Salt gets into everything. The weather changes without warning. People make their living on the water and are used to losing things to it.

Talent: one Might die to d8.

  • Salt-Toughened. The first time each conflict an Attribute of yours would take Stress, reduce that Stress by 1, ignoring Resistance.
  • Undertow. You learn the Undertow Technique: Grappling, Stress, Prone, -1 Oppose.
